chapters.title: Validation at a glance
chapters.subtitle: Healthy, validated cells are marked green.

captions.text: Every project opens to real content — source and target, side by side.
Click a file in the sidebar to open it.
Left: the source — “In the beginning was the Word.”
Right: your team's French — “Au commencement était la Parole.”
Each cell carries a health signal — green means a reviewer validated it.
The status bar rolls up exactly how much is translated and validated.
Real French scripture, real validation — that's how you read a project in Aquilla.
